verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a static SES API v2 reference (the API_SendEmail pages) and machine-readable docs (llms.txt, .md pages). Nothing shows an interactive API explorer or runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 at every candidate path. A static reference and LLM-friendly docs are adjacent features, not the interactive, runnable reference the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
